summary: Introduce an experimental layout and list-page composition slice with AI-consumer instructions and automated checks so teams assemble En UI pages using approved components, tokens, spacing, responsive behavior, truncation, and accessibility rules.

components: Add experimental layout primitives and TruncatedText without modifying existing stable component APIs.
consumers: Add an opt-in AI skill and deterministic consumer checks; no migration is required.
contracts: Add experimental layout and list-page composition contracts without changing stable component contracts.
documentation: Document the composition-first workflow, allowed primitives, AI instructions, and guardrail diagnostics.
foundations: Reuse current semantic spacing, color, typography, focus, mode, and density tokens; add no raw visual values.
patterns: Prove a responsive list-page composition with PageHeader, FilterToolbar, and EmptyState.
screenshots: Review the list-page story at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

verticalSlice.name: Responsive list page
verticalSlice.workflow: Compose a page header, token-spaced filter toolbar, responsive results layout, accessible truncation, and empty state using En UI primitives.
verticalSlice.evidence: Experimental contracts, colocated tests and stories, mobile/tablet/desktop Storybook review, accessibility checks, and consumer guardrail fixtures.
